method: Current main, preload and production renderer through native Electron interactions. Isolated account-local data copies only the protected saved connection and device identity. DJ automation is stopped and provider network destinations are blocked. Live server reads and writes use the actual service; independent direct server reads confirm raw metadata and playlist order. Album rows and playback queues are compared with the complete ordered albumTracks service result; the service requests disc, track and sort-name order.
mutationBoundary: Only one uniquely named temporary private playlist per run. No mutation to an existing personal playlist is permitted. Cleanup verifies exact owned identity/name, deletes that playlist and confirms 404 absence. The earlier selector-failure run also deleted its temporary playlist and verified 404.
driverCorrections: Wait for virtual row zero after scrolling before capturing its identity.
Artwork fallback is an image role with a descriptive accessible name.
Choose a live multi-track album from actual song album IDs, since album ChildCount was absent. The final sample has six tracks.
Select the destination by its combobox role; the wrapping label includes option text and did not match the earlier exact-label locator. No app defect is attributed to these driver mistakes.

priorEvidence.overlap: 2026-10-16-catalog-union-current.json contains controlled partial/full overlap and alias coverage. Current catalog concurrency and two-root paging are covered by 2026-10-17-catalog-view-concurrency.json.
priorEvidence.sourceFreshness: No application source changed after cf3dd08f. Current native fixture builds actual main with only scheduler/test hooks, hidden initial window, protected connection seeding and shared-key lookup disabled. Renderer and preload use the existing production build.
priorEvidence.richMetadata: The current native controlled sample additionally exercises genres, tags, track/disc, codec and audio fields absent from the live sample.

checks.buildTypeScriptLint: Application source unchanged from PR41 passing build/TypeScript/full ESLint; not repeated.

limits: The authorized live server exposes one accessible music root with 1317 songs. Live overlapping roots cannot be claimed; overlap coverage is controlled.
Live metadata is sampled, with missing rich fields covered by the controlled native fixture. This is not an exhaustive audit of every personal media file.
The live six-track album and guarded playlist writes establish ordered actions on this server/runtime; other server versions need separate evidence.
Muted playback does not establish audible quality or listener comprehension.
No smaller than 1280x720 or enlarged-zoom checks ran. The overall goal remains open.
